How far they can go.

While everyone’s chasing numbers.
We’re chasing proof.

The kind that shows up before 
the camera ever does.
These names didn’t arrive loudly. 
They arrived ready.

Built in empty gyms, 
long mornings, 
unshared wins.

And if you’re still in it 
with the work, the doubt, the silence.

Keep going. 

Because merit has its way of surfacing.
And we’re always watching.

This is her story. And she has only just begun.
